  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 7:56 a.m. the meeting was called to order. Chair Sanders presiding.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Sanders, Schwerin, St Bernard, Betancourt, Curtis, Lesen, McNeeley,
Red Eagle, Walton, Clark, Van Meeveren

Commissioners Absent: Girgis, Gupta, Tejani, Vaias

Also present: Dennis Keith, Executive Assistant, Alison King, Acting Director of Health & Human
Services.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-51670  Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Board of Health and Human
  Services meeting held Friday, December 8, 2023.

  A motion was made by Member St Bernard, seconded by Member Curtis, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  11 Sanders, Schwerin, St Bernard, Betancourt, Curtis,  Lesen,
  McNeeley, Red Eagle, Walton, Clark, Van Meeveren
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 4 Girgis, Gupta, Tejani, Vaias

2.  24-51671  Recommendation to receive and file a report from the Acting Director of Health and
  Human Services.

  A motion was made by Member Lesen, seconded by Member Walton, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  11 Sanders,  Schwerin,  St  Bernard,  Betancourt,  Curtis,  Lesen,

  Alison King, Acting Director of Health and Human Services, informed that Board
  that the Department was currently engaged in the Fiscal Year 2025 Budget
  Process. She informed that Board that the Governor’s budget anticipates a $68
  billion deficit over the next two years. Department staff are engaging the assistance
  of a consultant to look at the Health Department’s budget and work is in progress to
  identify efficiencies.

3.  24-51672  Recommendation to conduct the annual nomination and election of officers.

  Chair Sanders opened the floor to nominations for the position of Chair. The Board
  nominated Chair Sanders for a second term. There were no other nominations for
  Chair.

  Chair Sanders opened the floor to nominations for the position of Vice Chair. The
  Board nominated Vice Chair Schwerin for a second term. There were no other
  nominations for Vice Chair.

  A motion was made by Member Betancourt, seconded by Member Curtis, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  11 Sanders, Schwerin, St Bernard, Betancourt, Curtis,  Lesen,
  McNeeley, Red Eagle, Walton, Clark, Van Meeveren
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 4 Girgis, Gupta, Tejani, Vaias

4.  24-51673  Recommendation to discuss Board goals and infrastructure.

  Board member Betancourt introduced Mr. James Suazo, Executive Director of Long
  Beach Forward, who agreed to assist the Board by facilitating discussions and work
  regarding the Boards vision and goals.

  Mr. Suazo provided a brief background on Long Beach Forward’s mission and his
  role to assist the Board to help build a foundation of goal setting. Mr. Suazo
  provided a brief recap of the Strategic Planning Subcommittee meeting, and
  facilitated an exercise to assist the Board in drafting a vision statement. A
  discussion ensued regarding the Board’s role and purpose.

  Page 2 of 3
   BOARD OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES MINUTES
  FRIDAY, JANUARY 12, 2024
  3861 WORSHAM AVENUE
  HEALTH DEPARTMENT TRAINING FACILITY, 7:45 AM

  Boardmember Van Meeveren exited the meeting at 8:36 a.m.

  Ms. King suggested sharing the City’s Public Health and Safety Committee meeting
  dates and times with the Board, notifying Board members when a meeting has
  been scheduled so that Board members would have an opportunity to attend or
  speak, as needed.

  Mr. Suazo informed the Board that he would meet with the Strategic Planning
  Subcommittee again prior to the February 2024 Board of Health Meeting to provide
  some additional work on the vision statement. He will bring the results back to the
  Board at the February meeting for discussion.

  Boardmember Clark briefly discussed having Board members confirm their
  attendance well ahead of scheduled meetings to ensure that there is a quorum
  ahead of the scheduled meeting date.

  A motion was made by Member Lesen, seconded by Member St Bernard, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  11 Sanders, Schwerin, St Bernard, Betancourt, Curtis,  Lesen,
  McNeeley, Red Eagle, Walton, Clark, Van Meeveren
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 4 Girgis, Gupta, Tejani, Vaias

PUBLIC COMMENT

There was no public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Chair Sanders announced that she had been asked to assist with the review and recruitment process
for the Director of Health and Human Services position. She will provide additional information as it
becomes available.

ADJOURNMENT

At 9:15 a.m. the meeting was adjourned.
